decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD is a low-cost catalogue item for an established music retailer, and after only one year with a dedicated page there is no clear evidence of a shortfall against aspiration, so slack lets the firm keep carrying it while CD demand is still uncertain.

The illustrated music release series is a newer series format whose results are still uncertain after one year, and without a visible performance gap triggering problemistic search, management keeps it on the market to learn more.
